tools.name: isrc_lookup
tools.description: Look up a recording by its ISRC. Returns the title, artist, release, and links from the same public catalog as the ISRC lookup page.

tools.name: search_track
tools.description: Search the public music catalog by song title and artist. Returns the closest recordings and their ISRC codes.

tools.name: reel_song_info
tools.description: Read free public info for an Instagram Reel, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, or X link. Returns a saved public match when one exists, otherwise the title published on the post. Does not run audio recognition. The site runs an audio check for Instagram, TikTok and X at https://reelsongfinder.com/.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: reel_song_info · Public sink: reel_song_info · Destructive: reel_song_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: reel_song_info · Public sink: reel_song_info · Destructive: reel_song_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
